pbmc_multiome_10k.title: 10x Multiome PBMC 10k (RNA + ATAC), annotated
pbmc_multiome_10k.description: Paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq of human PBMCs (10x Genomics Multiome), 9,631 post-QC cells. Raw counts in .X; cell-type annotations in obs['cell_type'] from Seurat label transfer against the Hao et al. (2021) PBMC reference.

hao_citeseq_pbmc.title: Hao et al. (2021) PBMC CITE-seq (RNA + 228 ADTs)
hao_citeseq_pbmc.description: Paired RNA and antibody-derived tag (ADT) counts for human PBMCs with hierarchical annotations in obs['celltype.l1'], obs['celltype.l2'] and obs['celltype.l3']. Source: GEO GSE164378.

pbmc_multiome_bridge.title: Multiome reference with unpaired RNA (Ding) and ATAC (Satpathy) query cohorts
pbmc_multiome_bridge.description: Paired 10x Multiome PBMC reference plus independent scRNA-seq (Ding et al. 2020, GSE132044) and scATAC-seq (Satpathy et al. 2019, GSE129785) PBMC cohorts, with harmonized coarse labels.

teaseq_pbmc.title: TEA-seq PBMCs (RNA + ADT + ATAC)
teaseq_pbmc.description: Trimodal TEA-seq PBMCs from Swanson et al. (2021), GEO GSE158013, with a per-cell 'well' annotation.

aml_mosaic.title: AML mosaic: CITE-seq bridge, van Galen scRNA-seq and DAb-seq
aml_mosaic.description: Paired AML CITE-seq (Knorr et al. 2023, GSE220474), scRNA-seq with sparse genotypes (van Galen et al. 2019, GSE116256) and DAb-seq protein + genotype (Demaree et al. 2021, PRJNA602320).

shareseq_mouse_skin.title: SHARE-seq mouse skin (RNA + ATAC)
shareseq_mouse_skin.description: Paired SHARE-seq RNA and ATAC from late-anagen mouse back skin (Ma et al. 2020), GEO GSE140203 / GSM4156597, with original cell-type annotations.

scnmt_gastrulation.title: scNMT-seq mouse gastrulation (RNA + CpG + GpC)
scnmt_gastrulation.description: Parsed feature-level bundle distributed by the EBI for Argelaguet et al. (2019), GEO GSE121708. Loaded into RNA, CpG-methylation and GpC-accessibility AnnData objects with success/coverage layers.
